column1: # The retrieval query set. One source, read by every retriever's evaluation, so the
# numbers are comparable — a query set copied into a second evaluation drifts, and two
# scores measured on different questions say nothing about each other.
#   Echo        the query shares vocabulary with the gist; lexical should be near-perfect
#   Paraphrase  the same meaning in different words; the vocabulary-mismatch case, and
#               the one a semantic backend exists to fix
#   Identifier  a metric name, path or symbol; lexical should beat any embedder
# No query reuses a gist verbatim. A set built by copying gists scores perfectly against
# any tokeniser that does not corrupt its input, and reports that as evidence.
